answer: Because the shale count is verified against the zenith text itself, the voyage audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. Filling 72 aliases hence means producing 72 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 7 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. That is 40 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
